overrides.reason: DGELSS picks its path (QR first, LQ first, or direct bidiagonalization) from LWORK. On exit A holds the right singular vectors in its first min(M,N) rows, but singular vectors are determined only up to sign (and within the subspace of a repeated singular value), so a different path can return different ones; the remaining rows are scratch. Rows N..M-1 of B, when M > N, carry the residual, which the reference defines only through its sum of squares ("the residual sum-of-squares ... is given by the sum of squares of elements n+1:m"), in a basis that depends on the path. S, RANK and rows 1..N of B (the solution) do not depend on LWORK; the module's tests check the solution at the minimum WORK (ticket 0096).

set.params.A.workDependent: on exit A's right singular vectors are determined only up to sign, and which ones LWORK's path returns differs; its other rows are scratch
set.params.B.workDependent: when M > N its rows N..M-1 hold the residual in a basis that depends on the path LWORK selects; only their sum of squares is defined
